summary: no-mistakes là một hook Git để ngăn chặn lỗi khi đẩy code, đảm bảo tuân thủ quy tắc và chất lượng trước khi thay đổi được đưa lên remote.
usecases: Enforce commit message conventions and branch protection rules in team workflows.
Block pushes containing sensitive data or violations of project coding standards.
Act as a gatekeeper for CI/CD pipelines by rejecting non-compliant pushes.
ideas: Extend as a pre-commit hook to catch issues earlier in the development cycle.
Provide custom error messages and auto-suggested fixes for common violations.
Integrate with issue trackers to automatically link blocked pushes to relevant tickets.
